note: Links to freely available sources, downloaded by each user to their own computer for their own use. Nothing here is redistributed by oc-knowhow.

sources.title: Handbook of Biological Statistics (3rd ed.)
sources.license: free to read and print; see biostathandbook.com/permissions.html
sources.useFor: choosing a classic test for a given data type (nominal vs measurement, paired, nested), worked explanations of chi-square/G-tests, ANOVA variants, regression basics
sources.note: Sound core; outdated where it recommends normality/variance pre-tests to pick a test, a fixed 0.05 cutoff, stepwise regression, Student's rather than Welch's t-test by default, and SAS/spreadsheets. Follow the stats-inference skill on those points.
